sources.citation: Simpson, Hazel J. (revised by Christine DeVisser). 2013. Bamukumbit (Mankong) Orthography Guide, 2nd edition. Yaoundé: SIL. 25 pp. (SIL Language & Culture Archives entry 58667)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Section 3 'Tone' (pp. 12-13) describes five surface tones (H, M, L, low-falling, high-falling, rising) and lexical tone minimal pairs; a full-text search for stress/accent/prominence = 0 hits. Direct SIL download is behind an automated-access block; archived copy (Internet Archive, 13 Aug 2024).

sources.note: Nothing. Section 1.5 'Transcription and Orthography' (pp. 10-11) gives only the tone transcription (H, L, HL, HM, LH, downstep; 'All "mid" tones are analysed as downstepped H tones'). No stress or accent mentioned. downloaded via the Internet Archive (id_ redirect); scanned at 300 dpi, tesseract eng.
